subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that means the same as the underlined group of words to fill in the blank.

Most of the rivers dry up during the summer season, but the Ganga is full of water __round the year__ because it is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**perennial**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**perennial**" means lasting or existing for a long or apparently infinite time; enduring or continually recurring. (अनवरत)
 
• A river that flows continuously throughout the year regardless of the season is considered perennial.
 
• The other options: "**biennial**," "**biannual**," and "**annual**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Most of the rivers dry up during the summer season, but the Ganga is full of water round the year because it is perennial__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Biennial (द्विवार्षिक)**: means taking place every other year.
 
• **Biannual (अर्धवार्षिक)**: means occurring twice a year.
 
• **Annual (वार्षिक)**: means occurring once every year.

2f:Tca8,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**
